content: Google Play Device and Network Abuse policy (official page verified): prohibits apps that access or use a service or API in a manner that violates its terms of service - the hook used to remove YouTube downloader apps (community/older policy text explicitly named downloading, monetizing, or accessing YouTube videos in violation of YouTube ToS). YouTube API developer policies explicitly prohibit enabling downloads. Downloader apps are routinely removed from Play; an Android app that downloads YouTube audio/video on-device (as ShortifyLocal AI does via NewPipeExtractor) carries a real takedown risk. Mitigations observed in the wild: upload-your-own-video first, disclaimers, or distribution outside Play.
